why: idx rg3 (rg3p 26,984 / rg3nqq2 32,218 sinks, spread 223-245 ps) and gunit l1f_m (25,954 sinks, spread 162/139 ps) fail the clock rule by construction: one ck port, one tree over the whole tile. Successor = hardened band children, each with its own small tree and registered faces.
method: flop census: yosys 0.68 proc+flatten, hslice blackboxed (rg3 params IH1 KR1 OH2 RH2 = the rg3p kit; l1f with OT_S81_GUNIT_FWDOWN). Tracks per seam: parent-level M4 0.048 + M6 0.064 for a vertical seam (horizontal wires); M3 0.036 + M5 0.048 for a horizontal seam; over-the-top only on M6 (horizontal) above M5-capped bands; 20% PDN derate. Landed rg3 crossings: D 2 / E 1 / K 1 -> the ring bank carries 2 W wires (+ epo / vld).
